title: Elysion Calendar
subtitle: Find a karaoke room, without the tab shuffle
description: A room-availability calendar for Elysion karaoke. Compare rooms and half-hour slots in daily and weekly views, using the shop’s official booking data.
longDescription: A small web app that reads Elysion’s official booking page and presents private karaoke-room availability as room cards, a daily timetable and a weekly overview. Mobile layouts and Taiwan-time slot handling make it easier to find a free room.
mascotLines: The old parser let a seven-hour booking end at 30:30.
Some people care more about JOYSOUND or DAM than the time slot. The cards say which.
imageCaptions: On a phone: room cards, the time table, and the weekly overview in dark mode
Weekly overview: free rooms per half hour; past days just say the site has no data
features: Room cards, daily timetable and weekly availability
Official booking-page data with background caching
Taiwan-time handling for past and current slots
results: Room availability organised around the shop’s booking data
why: Elysion's booking page shows one day at a time, with a separate table for every room, so finding a free room means reading them all. This app reads them for you and lines the rooms up. It only needs a backend because the official site will not let pages from other sites read it.
gains: Handy when a group is picking a night: the weekly overview counts the free rooms in every half hour, and each card says whether the room runs JOYSOUND or DAM, a question some singers take very seriously.

lessons: The old parser counted hours by hand from 9:00, so a 7-hour booking from 23:30 ended at "30:30"; the grid now comes from the page's own hour labels.
Every uncached day answered HTTP 500: the Redis lock was released by its key string instead of the lock object, and a freshly written cache hid it.
Cache hits used to fetch the official site every time; now a copy is served as is for five minutes and refreshed in the background.
